effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Gammamon] in its text and 1 [Hiro Amanokawa] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Gammamon] in its text, it gets +2000 DP.
